title.narrative: Operational support to the Ministry of Interior Affairs

description.narrative: This collaboration reflects a shared commitment to strengthening the operational capacities of the police service and supporting the broader goals of security sector reform in Montenegro. Properly equipped officers are better positioned to carry out their duties in line with international standards, particularly in challenging or crisis-prone environments, and to meet the requirements of EU-compliant policing. In this regard, UNDP can play a key role by:1) Ensuring that the legal framework stipulating technical requirements of equipment is aligned with best international practices and 2) Facilitating transparent procurement processes and3) Designing and an information system to monitor procured equipment and identify renewal and replacement needs.The subsequent steps in this process will involve:1. Conducting thorough market research of the producers providing the relevant sophisticated police equipment.2. Developing a draft budgetary estimate for substantive support to the police.3. Drafting a comprehensive project document that outlines a well-defined set of outcomes and outputs.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
